name: swinging-door
prompt: Make a door that swings: a doorframe post (fixed) and a wooden door 1 m wide and 1.9 m tall hinged on the post's edge so it swings open and shut about a vertical axis, limited to 100 degrees either way. In play mode I can grab and swing it. Put it on a floor.

name: pendulum
prompt: Make a pendulum: a horizontal ceiling beam (fixed) 3 m up, a thin rod hanging from it on a hinge so it swings in one vertical plane, and a heavy ball welded to the rod's lower end. Start it pulled out to the side so it swings when I press play.

name: bouncing-spring
prompt: Make a weight hanging on a spring: a fixed hook up high and a 0.4 m cube hanging below it on a spring (rest length 1 m) that starts stretched, so it bounces up and down when I press play.

name: doorbell-lamp
prompt: Make a doorbell: a gold bell (fixed) with a ball above it that falls on it when I press play; when the ball touches the bell a lamp beside it lights up (a glowing sphere that turns on). Use a collision trigger and a flag.
